title: ci(docs): use withastro/action@v6 (Node ≥22) to fix Pages deploy
body: ## Summary The post-merge **Docs** deploy from #7 failed at `Build with Astro`: `withastro/action@v3` defaults to Node 20, but Astro 6 requires `>=22.12.0`, so `astro build` aborted with `Node.js v20.20.2 is not supported by Astro!`. Fix: bump the action to `withastro/action@v6` (defaults to Node 24 via `actions/setup-node@v6`, which also clears the Node 20 deprecation warning) and keep `node-version: 22` pinned to match the version the site is built/tested against. ```diff - uses: withastro/action@v3 + uses: withastro/action@v6 with: path: ./docs + node-version: 22 ``` No content changes; the site already builds locally on Node 22. Once merged, the Docs workflow will publish to https://exonical.github.io/rootseal/. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/809a75bcfd14493ea1c78f60d5369cac Requested by: @Exonical ---
